GOV-F-004-S38.title: Runtime Audit Hook Integration (GPT/Claude + Tools)
GOV-F-004-S38.description: Integrate audit logging hooks into the main execution flow including GPT/Claude responses, tool_router dispatch, safety_service triggers, and consent flows. Ensure every operation emits a structured audit event using the defined schema.

GOV-F-004-S39.title: Audit Log Integrity Verification and Tamper Detection
GOV-F-004-S39.description: Implement a verification utility that recomputes hash chains across audit log records to detect tampering or gaps. Provide validation endpoints or internal checks that can be triggered during QA/SIT to confirm log integrity.
